candidates.hypothesis: Replica CS/ES0FFC matches the original scanner exclusion and changes exposed far-call segment signature. Shift startup SP+10h so code and paint physical positions translate together with identical barrier/copy timing.
candidates.edits: Affected warrior OR DX immediate0FFB->0FFC; A startup SP+100->+110 and/or B+600->+610. Original byte layout, worker IP, AX lowA2, DX/BP stride, word counts retained.
candidates.failureModes: Physical phase translates+10h and can favor opponent bombs; FFC-specific enemies might recognize the new signature. Own captured A scanner ignores affected teammate frames but also any rivalFFC.
